pages.name: Prismarine Bee
pages.text: Bubba Star. Overworld, by day (also works in rain).

Its gem costs a sponge, once.$(br2)$(l)Flowers:$() Prismarine, Prismarine Bricks, Dark Prismarine, Sea Lantern$(br2)$(l)Home biome:$() Deep Ocean, Deep Cold Ocean, Deep Lukewarm Ocean, Deep Frozen Ocean$(br2)$(l)Brings home$() (busy hive):$(li)Prismarine Honeycomb: every trip, 210 per hive-hour
$(l)Water-safe:$() Works in the rain and takes no damage from water.
Use it on a vanilla bee.
